# pqtransport

Pure-Dart post-quantum transport for Dart and Flutter.

- Package: https://github.com/turkananation/pqtransport
- Site: https://turkananation.github.io/pqtransport/
- Wiki: https://github.com/turkananation/pqtransport/wiki
- Docs: https://github.com/turkananation/pqtransport/blob/main/doc/INDEX.md
- Claim boundary: https://github.com/turkananation/pqtransport/blob/main/doc/CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md
- Crypto: package:pqforge ^0.4.10 (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, AES-256-GCM, AES-128-GCM, dart2js-safe ChaCha, X25519, P-256/P-384 ECDH and ECDSA, HKDF, X.509, HPKE)
- Infra: package:swissarmyknife (Result, StateMachine, CircuitBreaker, Cache)
- No dart:ffi. No platform TLS on the PQ path.
- Live handshake: all three RFC 10024 groups. P-384 requires PqForgeProfile.maximum. Profile/group mismatches fail closed (requireGroup). Fallback groups, when the peer offers only those: X25519, secp256r1, secp384r1, MLKEM1024.
- TLS encoding is RFC 8446-shaped. Cipher IANA 0x1302 (SHA-384 AES-GCM, default) and 0x1303 (ChaCha). Default certificate is RFC 7250 raw ML-DSA-65. Opt-in X.509 is a caller-supplied chain of 1 to 8. Not WebPKI. Not a browser.
- OpenSSL 3.5.9: the three hybrid groups, raw-pk and X.509, both directions, plus the four fallback groups. BoringSSL 0.20261020.0 is a TLS peer on X25519MLKEM768 and the four fallback groups, not SecP256r1MLKEM768 or SecP384r1MLKEM1024. curl is two HTTP/1.1 GETs. Not curl --http3.
- ECH (RFC 9849) is self-interop and one BoringSSL flight. DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) + AES-128-GCM via PqHpke. Not an OpenSSL flight. Not GREASE. Not DNS.
- DNSSEC verifies ECDSAP256SHA256 (algorithm 13) only. SHA-256 DS matches a caller-supplied DNSKEY. The AD bit is not validation. Not RSASHA256. Not NSEC/NSEC3. Not a recursive resolver.
- HTTP/2 is on PqTlsSocket (ALPN h2). HTTP/3 is on PqQuicConn (ALPN h3). Silent h2/h3 to h1 downgrade is refused. QUIC 0-RTT is not implemented (LIM-05).
- Not a FIPS 140 module.

Start at doc/INDEX.md. Do not invent FIPS/CMVP, constant-time, or erasure claims.
